scope: New operational monitoring collections and their legacy catchall exclusions only; prototype, not a whole-application security certification
summary: Verified identity, ownership, explicit opt-in, bounded allowlisted records, append-only events and administrator-only raw diagnostics are enforced. Teacher views are coarse admin-maintained snapshots. Deployment and operational privacy controls remain separate prerequisites.

findings.issue: Activity is client-reported and can be forged or omitted; no backend verification or rate budget exists.
findings.recommendation: Use these signals only for support and optional engagement context, never grading or discipline. Add trusted ingestion and abuse controls before scale.

findings.issue: Expiry timestamps are not automatic deletion. Old summaries persist until explicit refresh after consent changes.
findings.recommendation: Obtain approval for TTL policies and scheduled cleanup, establish school retention policy, and operationally refresh/remove snapshots and account data on request before enabling at scale.

findings.issue: Legacy academic staff reads remain broad and the current staff email mapping supports only the existing instructor; UI section filters are not multi-tenant academic authorization.
findings.recommendation: Migrate staff roles and class assignments in a separately reviewed backend change before adding instructors or claiming cross-teacher academic isolation.

findings.issue: Administrators control coarse projection rows and roster values; per-row academic correctness is trusted, not recomputed by rules.
findings.recommendation: Keep summaries non-grading, bounded and visibly attributed; use a trusted backend projection for stronger integrity and automatic consent removal.
